balls.text: Russell searches for another middle-stump yorker, this comes out as a slot ball. AB gets underneath the length and thrashes it over Russell's head once again
middle-stump yorker, dug back to the bowler
shortish and angling away outside off, AB sizes it up and nonchalantly lifts it over short third man for four. That hit thrills AB's family and his captain Kohli in the dug-out
on a length and finishes past the tramline. AB tries to reach out in vain. Russell has to rebowl it
nails the wide yorker, slanting across AB, shanked to sweeper cover
Russell ambles in from round the wicket and keeps missing his lengths. Full-toss on middle, AB drops down to one knee and sends the white ball disappearing over midwicket
back of a length and slanting away outside off, AB clears his front leg, widens his base and pumps it over the bowler's head. Pinged off the middle of the bat
punched down to long-on, this time by AB
Harbhajan is getting too predictable. Short, slow, spinning away. AB waits on it before launching it high over extra-cover. Powered away
punched down the ground

I toldja he can give it a good whack. Looped up outside off, Jamieson uses his reach and lofts it down the ground. He keeps long-off interested for a bit. Cummins leaps and lets the ball burst through his hands. Replays indicate Cummins didn't even get a hand to it
dropped short and spins away wide of off. Jamieson delays the cut, and cracks it hard to the right of sweeper. Well done, Jamieson
Harbhajan held this offbreak back outside off, finds extra bounce. Jamieson swings so very wildly and misses
may have been a slower ball outside off, AB swings early and edges it behind to DK
full-toss, slanting away outside off, Russell misses the yorker once again. It may have surprised other batsmen but not AB. He leans back and dabs it between DK and short third man
nails the wide yorker, stabbed wide of sweeper. AB hares back for the second
full and wide of off, Russell isn't running in at full tilt and then misses his length. AB drops down to one knee and carves it over point, beats deep third man to his right
Russell searches for another yorker outside off, this comes out as a low full-toss. AB makes it look a whole lot worse by launching it high over midwicket
off-side wide, left alone
wide yorker, darted across off, AB can't touch it

Cummins bounces Maxwell out with three overs left in RCB's innings. Lifter from over the wicket. Cummins chases Maxwell who was moving outside leg. Chest-high delivery, gets big on Maxwell. Top-edges a pull to short fine leg, where Harbhajan settles under this skier. Maxwell raises his bat and walks off to rousing applause from the RCB dug-out. Exceptional innings. Will it turn out to be a match-winning one?
bumper from Cummins, Maxwell backs away but can't connect with a flat-batted strike over the off side
AB has a hack at this short ball outside off and gets an inner edge that rolls as far as deep midwicket
short and outside off, Maxwell backs away outside leg and flat-bats it powerfully to long-off
dug in short on middle, Maxwell shuffles outside leg, aims a reverse-scoop, but it's away from his reach
banged in short and angling into the body, swivel-pulled to wide long-on
shorter and outside off, steered away to the left of sweeper cover
just short of a good length and angling into off, another on-pace ball from Krishna which disappears to the boundary. AB smites it to the midwicket fence
just short of the yorker outside off, AB gets underneath the length and carves it away to the left of Morgan this time
banged in shorter and on top of off stump, sliced only as far as Morgan at short cover
shortish and outside off, swatted across the line to deep midwicket. Shakib misfields in the deep with the sun squinting into his eyes
shortish and on the hips, picked off to long leg

Whoa! This blasted over the covers. This is a blameless middle-stump delivery. Maxwell pre-meditates and reverse-swats it in front of square on the off side. Fast hands and sublime timing. New ball, please. Make that 17 off Varun's last over

dragged down on middle, Maxwell hauls it away between deep midwicket and wide long-on. Tripathi runs across to his left from deep midwicket, slides in smartly, and swats the ball away to Gill running across to his right
legcutter? Short and wide outside off, slapped off the back foot to sweeper cover
AB saunters down the track, Varun drags his length back outside off. Smashed past the left of Varun and right of wide long-off
fired full on off, AB goes after Varun, throws his bat at ball and edges it thickly fine of short third man after beating DK first to his right
skidder, aimed at the top of off, chopped to point
short, wide, Maxwell knows that both point and third man are inside the circle. He reaches out for the ball and deliberately carves it over short third man. Top, top batting from Maxwell
another slower cutter pushed past the tramline. Cummins gets the offcutter wrong once again
slower ball, floated past the tramline, off-side wide
mighty full and slanting in at off, lashed to deep-ish mid-off for one
banged in short and outside off, AB can't get top of the bounce, chopped to Morgan at short cover
hip-high short ball outside off, hauled away to deep midwicket
shorter and outside off, guided down to deep third man. Clean pick-up and throw from Harbhajan this time
back of a length, angling in and straightening away outside off, steered more or less straight to Harbhajan at deep third man. A fumble allows AB the second
tossed up slower and higher outside off, Maxwell simply pushes it back to Varun
nudged off the pads through square leg
Maxwell, pre-meditates, going for a switch-hit, Varun pushes it really full. Squeezed through cover-point
driven down to long-off off the front foot
dinked to covers with an open bat-face
legcutter, shortish and outside off, carved off the back foot to sweeper cover
pitched up and outside off, drilled through the covers. Tripathi sprints to his right to intercept the ball. He has been terrific in the field
shortish and outside off, AB leans back and late-cuts it to the right of deep third man
fuller and outside off, squeezed to mid-off hanging back
dug in short and slanting in at the top of off, played back to the bowler
back of a length and straightens away outside off to beat the outside edge before settling into the gloves of DK

Krishna takes down his Karnataka team-mate. Hip-high short delivery outside off, Padikkal hauls a pull in the air. Dragged into the lap of Tripathi for a more straightforward catch. He didn't really get going. Falls for 25 off 28 balls
more intent from Padikkal. He leaves his crease to this flat offbreak outside off and pumps it over Harbhajan's head
Maxwell aims for a big reverse-sweep from off stump and ends up under-edging it to the covers
crunnnnnnched over extra-cover and Maxwell makes it look ridiculously easy. Shortish and outside off, but the ball isn't coming on. Maxwell, however, can manufacture his own pace
chopped from a middle-stump line to sweeper cover
darted on leg stump, Padikkal finally breaks free with a reverse-sweep over point. He loses his shape, but manages to lift it over the infield
back of a length and spins away outside off, the left-hander slashes and is beaten in the channel
hard-length delivery, skidding into off, inside-edged back to the bowler
short, wide, rifled away to backward point, where Rana, I think, lets the ball through his hands or past his hands. Maxwell's cut beats deep third man too
back of a length and outside off, 141.3ks, punched up to point with an open face
picked up and whipped away between long leg and deep midwicket
toe-ended in the air....did it carry to short cover? Back of a length on middle, Padikkal drives early, it bounces in front of Morgan
just short of a good length and outside off, heaved to wide long-on
much fuller and slanting into middle, patted down to long-on. Maxwell raises a 28-ball half-century. Animated applause from Kohli in the dug-out
Maxwell follows that flat-batted boundary with a swivel-pull in front of square
Cummins runs in hard, hits the pitch harder, cranks it up to 142ks. Maxwell backs away, dashes out of the crease, and swings it over extra-cover, tennis-style
shortish and outside off, Padikkal gets into position quickly and smears it to deep midwicket
back of a length and on the hips, tucked down to long-on
shortish and outside off, Maxwell rides the bounce and finds a single to deep third man
on a length and spins away outside off, this offbreak kicks up to Padikkal. He gropes at it as Varun draws a leading edge to cover
hard-length delivery on middle, shovelled off the back foot to deep midwicket
Padikkal works this middle-stump ball between deep midwicket and wide long-on. Padikkal has to settle with a single
on a length and outside off, legcutter, Maxwell opens the bat-face and glides it through cover-point region
short offbreak, finishes on the hips, flapped away behind square for another four, beating the man in the outfield
dragged down outside off, too short and some width from Varun. Maxwell camps back and whacks it over wide long-on for six
back of a length and spins away outside off, this legbreak is slashed out to extra-cover...and the no-ball siren goes off again
Maxwell meets this back-of-a-length delivery outside off with an open bat-face and drives smoothly to sweeper
similar length and skidding in towards the top of off, inside-edged to cover
back of a length and nipping back in to cramp Maxwell for room as he falls over the leg-side flick
short, wide, Maxwell manufactures more swinging room by stepping away outside leg. He scythes it flat and hard to the right of point. The free-hit is duly dispatched to the boundary
back of a length and slanting across off, now it's Padikkal's turn to angle his bat and secure a single to deep third man...and the no-ball siren goes off
shorter and outside off, Maxwell opens the bat-face and dabs it to deep third man
short and slanting in at the top of off, Maxwell recoils away from a line a touch and steers it off the face to point
drilled down to long-off. RCB have recovered well to 45 for 2 in six overs. Did Morgan miss a trick by not giving Varun another over?

Trick shot from Maxwell. He stands on leg stump or just outside, he then reverse-swats it over point from the stumps like only he can. It may be a high-risk shot for others but not so much for Maxwell
shimmies out and punches between deep midwicket and wide long-on
short, wide, Shakib is leaking runs with the new-ish ball. Padikkal leans back and cracks it hard between cover-point and backward-point
flat, quick, outside off, Maxwell hauls it across the line and against the intended spin to deep midwicket
tossed up on middle, a bit too full as Shakib lands it in the swinging arc of Maxwell. He clears his front leg, widens his strong base, and shanks it over midwicket. Bam
hip-high short ball outside off, Padikkal gets on the back foot and hauls a pull to the left of Dre Russ at mid-on
back of a length and angling across the left-hander, defended back to him
Padikkal opens the bat-face to this fuller one angling across him. Dinked down to deep third man
back of a length and on middle, punched away to the left of mid-on
Cummins pounds it on a heavy length and the line is outside off, 140ks delivery outside off. Maxwell jabs at it and sends an inside edge past leg stump
Maxwell rides the bounce of this 141.2ks short ball outside off and taps it to point with an open face
tossed up and spinning away outside off, Maxwell waits for it to spin, then flat-bats it down to long-off
full and holds its line outside off, Padikkal brings his wrists into play and whips it away between deep midwicket and wide long-on
back of a length and spins away outside off, flayed down to long-off off the back foot
fired outside off, lashed to extra-cover
dangled up on middle, fuller, and stops on Maxwell. Stabbed back off the inside half
darted just a shade outside off, Maxwell gives himself some room and slaps it away between backward point and cover-point
floated up outside off, calmly bunted along the ground to long-on
faster, flatter, drifting in to take the inside edge and roll away to the leg side. Another non-turner from Harbhajan
much fuller and slanting down the leg side for a wide
darted into the pads, right in the slot for the flick, but that's what pressure does to you: Padikkal can't put it away
tossed up on middle, driven back to the bowler
flatter and skidding away outside off, gathers pace off the pitch and beats the cut
fired on middle, jammed back to Harbhajan, who deflects it to cover

CV Varun is on fire at his home ground! He hits a heavy length and gets it to dart back in sharply into a crease-bound Patidar. The batter wafts it and the ball may have grazed the pad before disturbing the top of off. "Va va va," is the cry from DK behind the stumps. He sure loved it
shortish and on the hips, clipped away off the back foot to deep midwicket
darted outside off, looks like the offbreak from Varun, patted down to long-on
fired into the pads, a bit too full, whipped away to deep square leg

Belting catch from Tripathi. He runs back from extra-cover and pulls off a terrific catch. He gets into a side-on position at the end, but completes that tumbling take. This seems like a legcutter from Varun, swerves away outside off on an in-between length. Kohli aims to pump it over mid-off, but gets it off the outer half of the bat, slicing it in the air. Kohli isn't close to the pitch of the ball and then Tripathi then springs into action
fired on a back of a length on middle, forced to midwicket
slider from Harbhajan, keeps coming in at middle, Padikkal camps back and defends it back to the bowler
slower offbreak, shorter and spins away, but the new ball doesn't come on. Padikkal leans back and chops weakly to point
looped up on middle, drifting in from around the wicket, pings the front pad, beating the inner edge, but this seems to be heading down leg
down the track and driven with the spin to long-on
Kohli dashes out to his free-hit: a wide full-toss, Kohli flashes at it and under-edges it, nutmegs Karthik behind the stumps
flatter and quicker on middle, played back to him
on a length, slow turn for Harbhajan, the new ball shapes in, sticks in the pitch. The leading edge drops wide of the bowler
on-pace short ball on middle, cramps Harbhajan, flapped weakly through square leg
slower ball outside off, drilled past the bowler. Jamieson throws himself to his right from mid-off to intercept the ball
full and wide, slower ball at 119ks, sliced in the air, but in front of deep midwicket
lifter outside off, pulled away to the left of deep midwicket
yorker, bending in from wide of the crease, dug back to Harshal
Russell plays on. Good length and angling in towards off from over the wicket, swerves in to Russell. He swings lustily and ends up dragging it back onto his own stumps
full-toss, below the waist, spliced down to long-on. Just one off that over
slower bouncer, angling down the leg side, Russell ducks out of the way
Russell slinks around his crease, Siraj nails another yorker outside off, squirted to cover
another wide yorker from Siraj, jammed down to third man. Russell keeps the strike
wide yorker, dug out to cover
carved down to deep third man. Russell turns down the single
edged and taken by AB. On-pace back of a length ball, Jamieson shifts his line wide of off. He asks Cummins to reach out for the ball. Cummins gets to it but can only slice it behind to the keeper
pumped over long-on. First-ball six for Cummins. He reads this slower ball outside off, waits for it to arrive, and then launches it down the ground with immense power
Jamieson knocks over Shakib! The left-hander jumps across, exposing all three stumps. Shakib swishes and misses. Jamieson pings leg stump with a mighty full ball
fullish and in the slot once again, on-pace delivery, Russell mis-hits it wide of long-on
slower bouncer outside off, Russell hops and does not connect. Wide called for height
full and this slower ball lands right in the slot for Russell. He picks it up and smites a big six over midwicket
full and wide of off, Shakib hauls this offcutter to long-on
shorter and spins across off, this googly is slapped away to Jamieson at sweeper cover
another shorter legbreak, closer to the body, swished to Padikkal at sweeper cover
another short and wide legbreak from Chahal. Russell waits for it, before jumping back and flaying another cut, this time square through point. Russell goes 6,4,4,4
Chahal takes this legbreak wide of off. But the length is too short once again. Russell reaches out and scythes a cut in the air between backward point and extra-cover
tossed up and outside off, on a length, but Russell still lines it up and clouts it between deep midwicket and wide long-on. Rasping slog-sweep
half-tracker on off stump, a helmet-less Russell lines it up and whacks it high over midwicket
low full-toss on off, swiped away to deep midwicket. Bounces in front of the onrushing outfielder
full on the stumps, possibly another slower delivery, punched down the ground to long-off
slower ball wide of off, Harshal takes it away from Russell's swinging arc. Hauled down to long-on
middle-stump yorker, squirted down to long-on
back of a length and angling into the stumps again, heaved away to the right of long-on. The fielder overruns it, but intercepts the ball in the end
back of a length and skidding into middle, a crease-bound Russell plays it back to Harshal
Shakib searches for another ramp, Jamieson is wary of it. So, he darts a wide yorker and beats Shakib outside off
shortish on middle, Shakib jumps across off, waits for this slower offcutter to arrive. Then ramps it smartly over AB's head
slower bouncer, angling across the advancing Shakib. He can't put bat on ball
on-pace lifter outside off, Russell hops and fends it fine of short third man
slower ball again, back of a length and wobbles away outside off, stabbed to point
slower ball, floated wide of off, carved to the off-side sweeper
forced down to long-off
off-stump yorker, dug back to the bowler
Kohli makes no mistake this time. He runs across to his right from extra-cover and snaffles this. Harshal goes for the slower dipper outside off. Morgan slices it to the RCB captain
whipped to deep midwicket

Siraj and Chahal make a mess of this. Chahal runs back from short third man, Siraj to his right from point. In the end, neither gets a hand to this skier. Morgan top-edges this slower ball and gets away
full and dips outside off, 117ks, Morgan heaves to the leg side...and misses
AB misses a stumping chance. Not an easy one. Shakib shimmies out of the crease, Maxwell fires it at 100ks and wide of off. Fizzes out of the rough and out of AB's gloves
back of a length and spins away outside off, punched through the line to wide long-off
half-tracker on the leg stump, Morgan loads up and pummels it over midwicket, clears the longer side of Chepauk
flat and quick on the stumps, played back to the left of Maxwell
Shakib uses his feet again, Maxwell drags his length back and gets it to spin further. Dragged to long-on
pumped straight of long-off. He backs away to this length ball on middle, frees his arms, and lofts it confidently
wide yorker, jammed out to point. Good over from Harshal
pitched up and outside off, shovelled away to wide long-on with the bottom wrist
another slower ball, finishes on the hips, clipped through backward square leg
slower ball, 120ks, on middle, Morgan checks his shot and chops it to the off side
back of a length and running away outside off, Harshal takes it away from Morgan's arc. Sliced to extra-cover
on a length and on the pads, glanced to long leg
shorter of a length and skidding in to take the inside edge and dribble away to the leg side
drilled down to long-off
hard-spun offbreak from Maxwell, turn and bounce to beat the reverse-sweep. AB rides the bounce and takes it superbly with one hand
floated up on middle, right in Morgan's swinging arc. He clears his front leg and lifts it over long-on
slower length ball on middle, sliding in at the stumps, Shakib steps out and hacks it to deep midwicket off the inner half
pushed down to long-off
back of a length on middle, clubbed away to the right of deep midwicket
down the track and plinked to deep midwicket off the inner half
Washi slows it up and beats Morgan in flight, scooped to the right of him
Morgan ventures a reverse-sweep from outside off and top-edges it over AB's head
down the track and drilled down to long-off
whisked into the covers off the front foot
Chahal holds this legbreak back, sticks in the Chepauk pitch and pops up at Morgan. He almost chips it back to the bowler
tossed up and outside off, check-driven in the air. Chahal leaps to his right, but the ball doesn't stick. It bursts through his hands
perfectly-pitched googly, pitches on middle and rips away past the leading edge

Chahal pins Karthik. This is plumb, he knows it, and walks off. Nice and full from Chahal, wrong'un, zipping in to thump the pad. Karthik plays for the legbreak and misses it altogether, struck in front of middle
full on middle, played back to Chahal
may been been a wrong'un outside off, Morgan reverse-sweeps and misses...or he may got some bat on ball
back of a length on off, forced down to long-on off the back foot. Good defensive bowling from Washington
fired outside off at 99.3ks, stabbed back to Washington
back of a length and outside off, punched past Washington to long-on
on a length and drifts away to catch the outside edge and roll to short third man
straighter one from Washington, Morgan plays for turn and inside-edges it to the leg side
fractionally short and outside off, Karthik leans back and chops it through point
sliding down the leg side from around the wicket, AB can't collect the ball. Morgan and DK cross over
shorter googly, whipped from outside off to deep midwicket

Hauled straight to Padikkal at deep midwicket! Nice and full, drops on off, right in the slot for Rana. It spins in slightly at off, slog-swept to the outfielder. More relief than joy for Chahal. His first wicket this season
tossed up on middle, Rana opens up his stance, goes low and paddles it over the head of AB behind the stumps
slider, chopped from an off-stump line to point
wrong'un, back of a length and breaks away outside off. Rana camps back and jabs it just away from the reach of Kohli at slip
swept from just a shade outside off to long leg

Washi closes out the powerplay with the wicket of Tripathi. The last ball was 100ks, he cuts it down to 83ks outside off. Tripathi goes across the line but does so early. He splices a slog-sweep. Siraj runs back from midwicket and tracks down this top-edged hit
hard-length delivery, 100ks, hits the pad and rolls to short fine leg
flat and quick on middle at 101.3ks, but it's not that hard length that Washi usually hits in the powerplay. Slog-swept over the leg umpire
Rana leaves his crease again, takes a short ball from outside off and flays it to the left of backward point where Padikkal makes a smart save
Rana smokes Washington over long-on. On a length and outside off, Rana meets it early by stepping out. Muscled away
back of a length at off, 100ks, rushes Tripathi into dragging a slog-sweep through midwicket
inswinging yorker, finishes on middle, dug out to the leg side
down the track and squeezed back off the inner half as Siraj cuts his pace again
slower offcutter, nicked on the bounce to the keeper
on a length and angling into middle, Tripathi holds his shape nicely and hits it over the top. Hoisted in the air to the right of mid-on
pitched up and outside off, driven through the line to mid-off
Tripathi knows fine leg is inside the circle. He anticipates a full ball from Siraj, jumps across off, gets inside the line and scoops it fine of that infielder for four
back of a length and sliding into off at 101ks, punched down to long-on
Tripathi shuffles outside leg, Washi shortens his length further and thumps the thigh pad
flat and quick on middle, Rana drags a slog sweep to midwicket off the inner half
hard-length delivery outside off, Washi hits his spot, jabbed away to short cover. A direct hit could've put Tripathi in trouble at the non-striker's end
Tripathi jumps across off and deflects this offbreak to short fine leg
length ball, pushed through on off, Tripathi puts his head down and slaps it over Washi's head
looped up and spinning into leg stump, Rana bends forward to smother it
back of a length and ducking in, might have been a googly, punched off the back foot into the leg side
starts on middle, the length is shorter, forced to extra-cover off the back foot
darted into the pads, Tripathi can't get hold of the sweep. He may have edged it onto the pads again
wrong'un from Chahal. Tripathi steps out and ekes out an inside-edge onto the pad
tossed up and spinning into middle, Rana rolls out the sweep straightaway and strokes it to deep square
length ball on middle, Tripathi exposes his stumps and pumps it over extra-cover. The ball is sliding onto the bat nicely

Jamieson comes back with the slower ball and has Gill chipping it to mid-on. Offcutter from Jamieson, fuller on middle, Gill clears his front leg, but the lack of pace messes with his timing. He can only drag it to the right of mid-on. Excellent catch from Christian (subbing for Maxwell). Jamieson celebrates the early strike with a big roar
on-pace short ball. Short, wide, Gill manufactures more swinging room and cuts it uppishly. Launched over point, clearing the shorter boundary
hip-high short ball outside off, the ball comes onto the bat. Gill lines it up and swats it flat and hard over midwicket for six. Gill is showing everyone he can be a fast starter when needed
banged in shorter and closer to the body, stabbed back to Jamieson
rifled through the covers once again. He dashes out to this back of a length ball on middle, creates swinging room and scythes it between cover-point and extra-cover
back of a length and angling into off and middle, short-arm jabbed away to the right of mid-on
on a length and angling into a front-foot drive to mid-on
back of a length and angling in at off, check-driven to the left of Siraj
rifled through the covers. Gill sizes it up a short ball outside off and cracks it away between extra-cover and cover-point
back of a length and shaping down the leg side for a wide
shortish and closer to the body once again, chopped away to the right of point
he starts off with a back of a length ball angling away from Rana. He has a hard-handed slash and is beaten in the channel
